@welcome: heading of the first screen a new install shows, also that screen's name for screen readers. Thought Desk is the app's name: keep it as it is
lead: Your notes, classes and deadlines in one quiet place. Everything stays on this computer.
@nameLabel: label above the field for the name the Home screen greets you by

look.title: Make it yours
look.@title: heading of the welcome step that picks the theme, accent colour and font
look.lead: Pick what feels right. You can change any of it later in Settings.
look.@appearance: label above the choice of a light, dark or system theme
look.@system: theme choice: light or dark as the computer is set
look.@accentColor: label above the row of colours for buttons, links and highlights
look.@writingFont: label above the choice of font for the text of notes
look.@fontSample: a sample drawn large in each font choice (not read out): two letters of your script that show what a font looks like
look.@sans: font choice: the app's usual sans-serif font
look.@sansNote: line under the Default font choice
look.@serif: font choice: a serif font, with small strokes at the ends of letters
look.@serifNote: line under the Serif font choice
look.@mono: font choice: a monospaced font, every letter the same width
look.@monoNote: line under the Mono font choice

tour.title: Three things to know
tour.@title: heading of the welcome step with three tips
tour.lead: That's all you need to get going.
tour.@slashTitle: first tip's heading; / is the key that opens the menu of blocks: keep it
tour.slashBody: Headings, to-dos, tables, math and databases: type / on an empty line and pick one.
tour.@searchTitle: second tip's heading, beside the search shortcut (Ctrl+K)
tour.searchBody: Pages, assignments, events and files, as fast as you can type.
tour.@homeTitle: third tip's heading: the Home screen shows what's on today
tour.homeBody: Today's classes, what's due soon and every open to-do, in one place.

shortcutsAside: Forgot a shortcut? <kbd>{mod}</kbd><kbd>/</kbd> shows them all.
@shortcutsAside: line under the tips; each <kbd>…</kbd> is a key drawn as a keycap: {mod} is the shortcut key's name (Ctrl, or ⌘ on a Mac) and / is the slash key, pressed together to list every shortcut

done.title: You're all set.
done.@title: heading of the last welcome step, when no name was given
done.@titleNamed: heading of the last welcome step; {name} is the first word of the name they gave
done.lead: Home will help you add your courses and class schedule next. Start whenever you're ready.

@back: button that goes back to the previous welcome step
@skip: button on the first welcome step while no name is typed: goes on without one
@continue: button that goes on to the next welcome step
@start: button on the last welcome step that closes it and opens Home. Thought Desk is the app's name: keep it as it is
@stepOf: screen-reader name of the dots that show progress through the welcome; {step} is the current step's number, {total} how many steps there are

chips.@assignments: button in the Trash that shows only assignments; the number of them follows it
chips.@events: button in the Trash that shows only calendar events; the number of them follows it
chips.@files: button in the Trash that shows only files; the number of them follows it

kinds.@page: what a deleted item is, under its name in the Trash, before when it was deleted (Page · Deleted 3 minutes ago)
kinds.@assignment: what a deleted item is, under its name in the Trash, before when it was deleted (Assignment · Deleted yesterday)
kinds.@event: what a deleted item is, a calendar event, under its name in the Trash, before when it was deleted
kinds.@file: what a deleted item is, under its name in the Trash, before when it was deleted (File · Deleted Oct 3, 2025)

deleted.@now: under a deleted item's name in the Trash, when it was deleted less than a minute ago
deleted.@nowFrom: the same, saying where it was; {origin} is the parent page's path (Notes › Biology) or the assignment's course
deleted.@relative: under a deleted item's name in the Trash; {when} is how long ago, already worded: 3 minutes ago, 2 hours ago, yesterday
deleted.@relativeFrom: the same, saying where it was; {when} is how long ago (3 minutes ago, yesterday), {origin} the parent page's path (Notes › Biology) or the assignment's course
deleted.@date: under a deleted item's name in the Trash, deleted a week or more ago; {date} is the date, like Oct 3, 2025
deleted.@dateFrom: the same, saying where it was; {date} is the date (Oct 3, 2025), {origin} the parent page's path (Notes › Biology) or the assignment's course

trash.@filter: placeholder of the field that filters the Trash by name
trash.@deletePermanently: button (a bin icon) beside one item in the Trash that deletes it for good
trash.@noMatches: heading in the Trash when nothing matches the filter
trash.@isEmpty: heading in the Trash when there's nothing in it
trash.isEmptyHint: Pages, assignments, events and files you delete stay here until you remove them for good.
trash.restoreHint: Restoring a page brings back the sub-pages deleted with it.
trash.@restoreHint: line at the bottom of the Trash
trash.@emptyTrash: button that deletes everything in the Trash for good (empty is a verb here), and the confirming button of the dialog that asks first
trash.@deleteTitle: title of the dialog that asks before deleting one item in the Trash for good
trash.deletePage: “{title}” and its sub-pages will be deleted. You can’t undo this.
trash.@deletePage: text of that dialog for a page; {title} is the page's title
trash.deleteItem: “{title}” will be deleted. You can’t undo this.
trash.@deleteItem: text of that dialog for an assignment, event or file; {title} is its title or file name
trash.@emptyTitle: title of the dialog that asks before deleting everything in the Trash for good

emptyMessage.one: {count} item will be deleted, files included. You can’t undo this.
emptyMessage.other: {count} items will be deleted, files included. You can’t undo this.

trash.@emptyMessage: text of that dialog; {count} is how many items are in the Trash

@tagPlaceholder: placeholder of the field in the tag picker, which adds tags (#exam) to an item
@createTag: row in the tag picker that makes a new tag; {name} is the tag as typed, drawn bold with # in front (inside <tag>…</tag>)
noTags: Type to create your first tag
@noTags: shown in the tag picker while there are no tags yet

filePicker.@placeholder: placeholder of the search field in the file picker
filePicker.@upload: first row of the file picker: choose a file on this computer to add
filePicker.@matching: heading of the files in the file picker that match what was typed
filePicker.@library: heading of every file in the file picker before anything is typed (the file library)
filePicker.@noMatch: shown in the file picker when no file matches; {query} is what was typed
